definition: a list of dishes available at a restaurant
description: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

taps.phrase: to pour milk into a cup
